message: Hey neighbors! With the possibility of a blackout, I’ve been thinking about how nice it is to unplug every once in a while. It’s a great chance to rediscover some low-tech fun—think board games or storytelling by candlelight. I found a handy resource from the Red Cross that shares tips on how to prepare for power outages while keeping it light and enjoyable. Remember, it’s not just about being ready; it’s about making the best of the situation. What’s your favorite way to pass the time when the lights go out?
